title: Foreshadowing & Clue Board
planNotFact: Plans are not facts. Manuscript evidence, committed facts and author tracking are shown separately. These marks never change the manuscript or Canon.
threshold: Remind after more than this many chapters
overdueDefinition: A clue with planting evidence is flagged if still unresolved after more than {{count}} chapters (exactly at the threshold is not overdue). Counting follows book order across volumes, advancing only to existing prose or committed chapters. Most overdue clues appear first.
noWrittenChapter: No prose or committed chapters yet; overdue counts are not inferred.
empty: No clues yet. Add a foreshadowing plan in existing chapter planning, or bind a clue to manuscript evidence, to track it here.
noResults: No clues match these filters. Clear the search or show all clues.
loading: Gathering this project's clues and sources…
unknownElapsed: Planting location is unknown; no overdue count
trackingHelp: This is recoverable author tracking. Marking a clue resolved or linking a chapter never commits story facts or invents manuscript evidence for a plan.
saved: Tracking saved. The manuscript and confirmed story facts are unchanged.
noEvidence: No manuscript anchor or committed chapter record yet. Plans and manual marks cannot replace source evidence.
staleAnchor: This anchor is stale. Only the source chapter will open, without a fabricated location. Relocate it in the Knowledge Center.
chapterEvidenceOnly: This is a committed chapter record without a precise manuscript anchor.
incompleteProgress: Some prose is missing, unreadable or beyond the bounded preview. Progress may be incomplete; plans and assumptions will not be used to fill overdue counts.

errors.CLUE_BOARD_CHANGED: Clue tracking changed elsewhere. Refresh, review and save again. No changes were overwritten.
errors.CLUE_BOARD_INVALID_TARGET: The clue or resolution chapter was removed or belongs to another project. Refresh and select again.
errors.CLUE_BOARD_INVALID_RECORD: The local clue tracking file is damaged. The manuscript and story facts are unaffected. Restore the tracking file through Data Center history.
errors.CLUE_BOARD_INVALID_CHANGE: The tracking change is incomplete. Choose a valid status, chapter, or reminder threshold between 1 and 1000.
errors.CLUE_BOARD_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Review the affected clues and change summary, then explicitly confirm the batch save.

volumeHelp: Filter by volumes in planting, planned planting, resolution and evidence. Planned links remain plans.
draftsRetained: {{count}} tracking edits are unsaved and retained while filtering or searching this page.
trackingDiffers: Author tracking says “{{tracked}}”; current manuscript/committed evidence says “{{evidenced}}”. Manual marks do not replace textual evidence.
overdueReason: From {{from}} to {{to}}, {{elapsed}} chapters have elapsed in book order, exceeding the {{threshold}}-chapter reminder threshold, without a tracked or evidenced full resolution. This is a reminder, not a plot error.
windowHelp: This is an author plan, not an event that has occurred. The reminder threshold is calculated separately from chapters since planting.
windowInvalid: The earliest planned chapter is after the latest one. Correct the original plan if needed; no plan is changed automatically.
windowPassed: Current prose progress is past the latest planned resolution chapter without full resolution. You may revise the plan or keep it intentionally open.
resetTrackingHelp: Clear only the manual status override, keeping notes and linked chapters. Source evidence, manuscript and story facts stay unchanged. Save or cancel unsaved edits first.
trackingReset: Status now follows current source evidence; author notes and linked chapters were kept.
changedSinceEdit: The saved tracking record changed while you were editing. Your input is retained. Review the latest record above before saving; cancel editing to use the latest values.
removedDraft: The original clue was removed or archived. This page keeps your input so you can copy the note. It will not be written into another clue.
removedDraftInput: Note retained after source clue removal
selectedDraftsWarning: Some selected clues have unsaved edits. Use “Save selected drafts”, or cancel those edits first. Batch status changes will not overwrite them.
batchLimit: Up to {{count}} clues per operation. For more drafts, select a subset and use “Save selected drafts” with a separate review and confirmation. Nothing is automatically split, skipped or discarded.
batchMetadataOnly: Only this project’s author tracking, linked resolution chapters or notes will change. Manuscript, committed story facts, Canon and State stay unchanged. All targets are validated before one save; any invalid target rejects the whole batch.
batchObjects: Review the following {{count}} affected clues and the changes:
batchSaved: Saved {{count}} tracking records in one operation. The manuscript and committed facts are unchanged.
cancelAndRefreshBatch: Keep edits, close and refresh data
selectionBreakdown: {{count}} selected · {{visible}} in current results · {{hidden}} outside filters
addVisibleHelp: Keep existing selections and add the current filtered results.
selectionLimitHelp: Adding these results would exceed {{count}} selected clues. Narrow the results or clear some existing selections first.
